items.headline: OpenAI pledges to cover power costs and drop NDAs at future data centers after midterm backlash
items.summary: OpenAI published a National Community Compact for campuses it owns and a policy blueprint for lawmakers. It pledges to pay all power costs, end NDAs with public officials, and report water and electricity use. No penalties for noncompliance are specified.
items.why: After voters rejected data centers in dozens of midterm ballot measures, OpenAI's compact is the first binding set of commitments from a frontier AI builder on infrastructure transparency. Whether enforceable or not, it sets the template other companies will be measured against.

items.headline: FT: Anthropic plans to start IPO roadshow as early as next week, targeting pre-Thanksgiving listing
items.summary: The Financial Times reports Anthropic aims to begin marketing its IPO the week of November 9, with trading before Thanksgiving on November 26. The targeted valuation of $1.25-1.75T is well below the $2T investors hoped for before this week's tech selloff.

items.headline: New benchmark finds AI coding agents need human cleanup on nearly three out of four real-world tasks
items.summary: Co-Design Bench tested 10 models on real web-app change requests. GPT-6 Astra met about 70% of requirements but was fully correct on only 26.4% of tasks. Claude Opus 5 placed second and Grok 4.7 ranked last. Larger overhauls dropped all scores.

items.headline: Open-weight AI models now reach 90% of top closed models on autonomous cyber-attack benchmarks
items.summary: The Vals AI CyberOffense benchmark found DeepSeek V4.1 Flash scored 72.8% vs GPT-6 Sol Daybreak's 80.8% at roughly one-seventh the cost. The UK AI Security Institute says the gap between open and closed cyber capabilities narrowed to 4-7 months.
